description: A player for self-hosted audio files, with a seek bar and a transport row composed from built-in and custom actions.

props.srcObject: Sets the source to a MediaStream, MediaSource, or Blob object. Live streams report an infinite duration, so the time display shows elapsed only.
props.type: Media file type (optional). When set, the source is rendered as a nested `<source>` element so the hint is honoured.
props.crossorigin: Forwarded to the native audio element. Required for a `live` `v-audio-waveform` on cross-origin media, otherwise the element would play silence.
props.preload: Forwarded to the native audio element. The default `metadata` obtains the duration without downloading the whole file.
props.error: Puts the component in the manual error state.
props.autoplay: Starts loading the media file without waiting for the user to click. Playback begins once enough data is loaded.
props.loop: Restarts playback when the end is reached. The `ended` event is not emitted while looping.
props.muted: Mutes playback. Forwarded to the native audio element.
props.startAt: Moves progress to the specified time (in seconds) once the first media file is loaded. A later `src` change starts from the beginning.
props.disabled: Removes all interaction and dims the component.
props.rounded: Applies a border radius to the container.
props.readonly: Locks the seek surface. Playback, volume and custom actions stay usable.
props.showBuffer: Shows how much of the file has been buffered on the seek bar.

events.loaded: Emitted when the audio has loaded its metadata and is ready to be played.
events.ended: Emitted when playback reaches the end. Not emitted while `loop` is set.
events.error: Emitted with the native MediaError when the audio fails to load.
events.update:playing: Emitted when the playing state changes.
events.update:progress: Emitted when the playback position changes, as a percentage (0-100).
events.update:playbackRate: Emitted when the playback rate changes.
events.update:error: Emitted when the error state changes.

slots.controls: Replaces the control bar with custom content.
slots.prepend: Additional content on the left within the control bar.
slots.append: Additional content on the right within the control bar.
slots.time: Replaces the time text. Receives the elapsed, remaining and total time already formatted.
slots.loader: Slot used to replace the loader displayed while the audio is being loaded.
slots.error: Replaces the warning icon in the overlay shown over the controls in the error state. Receives the MediaError.
slots.sources: Slot for content placed within the native `<audio>` element.
slots.progress: Replaces the seek bar. Receives `props` to bind on `v-media-progress-bar` or `v-audio-waveform`.
slots.play: Replaces the play button. Receives `props` to bind on your own button.

exposed.stop: Pause playback and return to the start.
exposed.seek: Move the playback position with `{ to }` or `{ by }`. Numbers are seconds, strings ending in `%` are relative to the duration, e.g. `seek({ to: '50%' })` or `seek({ by: -10 })`.
exposed.retry: Clear the error state and load the source again.
